description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development, ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate and strategic leader, committed to fostering a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. This is an urgent opening, and we are looking to fill this position promptly with a qualified professional ready to contribute to our mission of providing exceptional care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 3-5 years of nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role
Prior experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) or long-term care setting
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience.

roleTitle: Registered Nurse Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse to step into an Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) role at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is a fantastic opportunity for a clinical leader to contribute to high-quality patient care and support the Director of Nursing in managing daily operations. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents and thrive in a dynamic environment, we encourage you to apply.

In this vital leadership position, you will play a key role in overseeing nursing staff, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and maintaining exceptional standards of care. This is a fast-moving opportunity with a competitive salary range, offering a chance to advance your career within a supportive team. Join us and help shape the future of resident care.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. We are seeking a skilled Registered Nurse (RN) to serve as our MDS Coordinator. In this vital role, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely completion of the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations and contributing to comprehensive care planning for our residents.

This full-time position offers a competitive salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year. We are looking for a committed professional to become a long-term member of our team, as we are not considering interim candidates for this role.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience with MDS 3.0
Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility setting
Strong assessment and documentation skills
Not an interim position
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, with a salary range of $65,000 - $75,000 per year.

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA, as a Full-time MDS Coordinator. This vital role is instrumental in ensuring accurate and timely resident assessments, contributing significantly to care planning and regulatory compliance. You will play a key part in optimizing resident outcomes and maintaining the highest standards of quality care.As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing individualized care plans, and collaborating with interdisciplinary teams. Your expertise will directly impact the quality of life for residents and the operational success of the facility. We are seeking a professional who is passionate about resident advocacy and meticulous in their documentation.This is a full-time opportunity offering a competitive hourly rate. We are looking for a long-term commitment to our team, not an interim placement. If you are an experienced MDS professional ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa (RN preferred)
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficient knowledge of MDS 3.0 and associated regulatory guidelines
Strong assessment, documentation, and communication skills
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience.
